analyzed_vuln.description: OptimizeMatrixShaper assumes matrix stage payloads are full 3x3 cmsMAT3 values and unconditionally casts stage Data->Double to cmsMAT3* before calling _cmsMAT3per. In this PoV, a malformed pipeline contains a matrix stage with only 3 doubles allocated (24 bytes, from MatrixElemDup), so _cmsMAT3per reads past the heap buffer while accessing row 1/2 elements. The crash happens in _cmsMAT3per (lcms/src/cmsmtrx.c:120), but the root cause is missing dimension/size validation in OptimizeMatrixShaper before treating matrix data as 3x3.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Via cms_transform_all_fuzzer, crafted profile data builds a transform pipeline matching the shaper-matrix-matrix-shaper optimization pattern. At least one matrix stage has inconsistent channel dimensions (not 3x3) yet is still accepted by cmsPipelineCheckAndRetreiveStages. OptimizeMatrixShaper then multiplies matrices as if both were 3x3, causing out-of-bounds read from the undersized Data->Double buffer and ASan heap-buffer-overflow.
